_meta.model: FAO-56 single crop coefficient, three Kc points (ini, mid, end), linear development and late-season interpolation
notes: Kc, root depth and p are FAO-56 (Allen et al., 1998) Table 12 / Table 22 style values entered from the author's knowledge of that paper; they must be re-checked against the published tables before pilot use.
Stage lengths are generic starting values, NOT calibrated for Rawalpindi planting dates or local varieties. Replace with Punjab Agriculture Department / PARC / NARC guidance.
root_depth_max_m uses the lower end of the FAO-56 range (conservative, matches shallower Pothohar soils). root_depth_ini_m is an assumption.
Crops here are candidates for Rawalpindi; local suitability has not been verified by this project.
